canonical_project: Uttar Pradesh data centre investment pipeline - Sitapur (state-approved cluster plan)
owner: Government of Uttar Pradesh / multiple prospective investors (not yet disclosed for Sitapur)
notes: ETDatacenters (23 Jun 2026) reports investment proposals totalling nearly Rs 21,343 crore approved under the UP Data Centre Policy 2021, to be distributed across Noida, Yamuna Expressway Region, Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Meerut and Sitapur, with an additional 644 MW of committed capacity under development statewide and a 2 GW by 2030 target. Sitapur is explicitly named among the locations but no Sitapur-specific site, developer or MW allocation has been published; treat as state-approved pipeline for the district, not a concrete facility.
